The inspiring events discussed involve courageous people who have risked their own lives to save others in times of peril. Drama reconstructions portray the incidents as they happened, with commentary and interviews with those saved and their saviours. Caught between life and death, these strangers had seconds to act as they bravely put their lives on the line and made a crucial difference. The first episode relives a moment, thousands of feet up in the air, as a group of six parachutists prepare for a routine jump. When one of the parachutists gets tangled in a chord his jump goes tragically wrong, leaving him dangerously hanging from the aircraft.
